يستنفوا (form X)
# يَسْتَنْفُوا (yastanfū) /jas.tan.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
# يُسْتَنْفَوْا (yustanfaw) /jus.tan.faw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
